notes.title: DESTRUCTIVE CREATIONS IS 10 YEARS OLD! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3]As part of our celebrations, we've chronicled the [b]DC history[/b] and showcased [b]new development[/b] and [b]publishing[/b] projects currently in the works ⤵️[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Mu8kJrtffGc;full][/previewyoutube]It might not be as fun as watching a cat fail compilation or your wedding video, featuring your favorite drunk uncle, but it’s light and fun whether you’re a DC fan, a DC hater [i](cheers to you!)[/i] or yet indifferent, but curious! 🎉🎉🎉
[hr][/hr][h3]Starting today, you can also try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] of our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]63 DAYS[/b][/url] title! 😎[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/ Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?
[hr][/hr][h2]🙇‍♀️ 𝐓𝐇𝐀𝐍𝐊 𝐘𝐎𝐔 𝐎𝐍 𝐁𝐄𝐇𝐀𝐋𝐅 𝐎𝐅 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐄𝐍𝐓𝐈𝐑𝐄 𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌! 🙇[/h2]

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
Fixed issues with Czech (QWERTY) keyboard layouts. Several other layouts were also affected by this issue, which should now also properly work.

To use these layouts however, you need to go into options and rebind the affected keys pressing your numerical keys. They will display what character there really is.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
A bit bigger update than yesterday's. This time we've fixed a few things as well as added those you requested. Here we go:
[olist]
[*]Timer is fixed (again) and now it properly displays hours instead of hundreds of minutes - easier to read
[*]Score above 100k will now properly fit into it's designed area
[*]AZERTY keyboards now also support full rebinding - which means that you can use the rebinding system to make 1,2,3,4,5 work without the need to switch to QWERTY layout
[*]Resetting the keybinds to their defaults now works properly
[*]The turret now rotates (Q/E) at a proper speed regardless of your framerate (previously it rotated slower on lower FPS making it harder)
[*]Cars no longer slow down with lower framerates - this issue made the game much easier for lower FPS scenarios
[*]Added Y-Axis invert and Mouse Sensitivity options in the Controls Menu
[*]Added Toggle Zoom option in the Gameplay Menu
[*]Added cyan crosshair color
[*]Leaderboards are now visible through steam
[*]Alt-Tabbing the game now properly enables the pause menu
[/olist]

We're currently working on the mouse issues (moving outside of screen etc.) and hope to release patch with it tomorrow along with some more fixes. No promises though. Feel free to send us feedback regarding this patch or talk about using forums.

Resetting the keybinds to their defaults now works properly
The turret now rotates (Q/E) at a proper speed regardless of your framerate (previously it rotated slower on lower FPS making it harder)
Cars no longer slow down with lower framerates - this issue made the game much easier for lower FPS scenarios
Alt-Tabbing the game now properly enables the pause menu

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Several very quick fixes to things that could be fixed so fast. What is included in this patch:[olist]
[*]The timer should now properly display times bigger than 99:59
[*]Your current score should no longer get cut in some resolutions when above 19999
[*]The skill tooltips should no longer move outside of the screen space
[*]Achievements that can be obtained after finishing levels should now properly unlock
[*]The achievement for completing the game should also work properly
[/olist]
In order to re-do the broken achievements you only need to play a map and finish it (the score is irrelevant). If they do not refresh, please report.

We've tested it a bit, but with so little time the fixes might not be perfect. Please, report if some of the issues listed above are still not fixed. Thank you.

PS. More in the coming days, we're not leaving everything else, we just need a bit more time for it.

The achievement for completing the game should also work properly
